## Key Tools (stealable patterns)
1. confusion-detector-steal.js - Pre-action confusion scanner — detects ambiguous context, conflicting data, unclear tool boundaries before production
1. schema-steal.js - Declarative coordination schema — replaces parsing 4108 lines of plan.md
1. completed-work-steal.js - Cross-references plan.md tasks with GitHub PRs, review threads, and CI status
1. pr-review-threads.js - Aggregates PR review threads and classifies blockers
1. agent-decision-stack.js - Runs RAG + evidence stack before non-trivial decisions
